name: Shojo Sotsugyou! ~Watashi de Doutei Sutemasen ka?~
original_name: 処女卒業っ！～私で童貞捨てませんか？～
source:
"On this auspicious day of graduation, today, we... are graduating from being virgins.
To our teachers who guided us so kindly and diligently, and to our fathers and mothers who watched over us warmly, and sometimes strictly...
Thank you so much. Please watch... as we become adults!"

At the school's graduation ceremony, the male and female student representatives, with tears in their eyes, read their words of gratitude.

Amidst the enthusiastic applause, the "Virginity Graduation Ceremony" finally begins.

In front of a large crowd, the male and female graduates, now in pairs, expose their well-developed genitals.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.swaneye.com/swan/syojyosotsu/index.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
“在这喜庆的毕业吉日，今天，我们……即将从处女与童贞之身毕业。
致一直温柔而又热心教导我们的各位恩师，致平日里温暖守护、有时又严格管教我们的爸爸妈妈……
真的非常感谢你们。请亲眼见证……我们长大成人的瞬间吧！”

在学园的毕业典礼上，男女毕业生代表眼含热泪，宣读着饱含感恩之情的答谢词。

在全场热烈的掌声中，“处女毕业典礼”终于正式拉开帷幕。

在众目睽睽之下，两两结成一对的男女毕业生们，纷纷袒露出了发育成熟的私处。
